sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No supplied canonical candidate verifies a member-owned strength property or a canonical cross-owner path from each structural member/load case to the ship-owned plasticStrength fact.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the plastic-strength definition query to compare ?strengthValue with ?expectedMagnitude (the absolute value of ?collapseValue), not with signed ?collapseValue. Remove the separate sh:sparql constraint requiring at least one structural-member load case: the requirement applies to every recorded applicable-member load case but does not independently require load-case existence.

Repair applicability for side structures: constrain the rule to bottom members or side members with nltl:transverseFrameOrientation true, and add a violation for every side-structure member lacking that required boolean selector so missing branch-selection evidence cannot pass. Apply the collapse-load, strength-definition, demand-versus-strength, and load-case checks only to that corrected applicable set; retain the bottom-only orientation and patch-load obligations.

Do not place nltl:plasticStrength on structuralMember: its supplied canonical domain/requiredOwner is benchmarkEntity/ship. A member-specific strength is required for the per-member demand comparison and collapse-load definition, but no canonical path or member-owned strength term is supplied. Locate the canonical cross-owner path or canonical member-strength property, then constrain and compare each load case only with its associated member strength; do not relocate or duplicate the ship-owned fact. Also require compatible declared units/conversion for combinedShearAndBendingDemand before comparing its numeric value with kN plastic strength.
